changelog: Shotgun resistome and MAG AMR can use AMRFinderPlus 4.2 with the current database (2026-08-07.1, 9,786 genes, was 8,342 in 2024-07-22.1). It goes into its own env: bash ~/r16s-app/setup_shotgun.sh --amr (env ngamp-amr); the WGS pipeline keeps AMRFinderPlus 3.12 and its database unchanged. The 4.x database files are read (fam.tsv, AMR_CDS.fa, shorter sequence headers) as well as the old ones, and the amrfinder that goes with the chosen database is the one used. Reads are now pooled per gene symbol, so point-mutation variants the 4.x catalogue lists separately (mecA-ceftar) count as their gene instead of a second row. Tested with AMRFinderPlus 4.2.7 and the 2026-08-07.1 database on simulated Illumina and Nanopore reads. No backend restart needed.
